source_caption_text:
Chrisean Rock Reveals She’s Getting Her #Blueface Portrait Tattoo On Her Face REDONE After She Went Through Multiple Painful Laser Removal Sessions 😭😳

Blueface, whose real name is Johnathan Jamall Porter, is a Los Angeles rapper who rose to mainstream fame in 2018 with his breakout hit “Thotiana.” Known for his unconventional flow, West Coast sound, and viral personality, Blueface quickly became one of the most talked-about rappers in California. Beyond music, he has remained in the spotlight through livestreaming, reality television, and his highly publicized relationships. His on-and-off relationship with Chrisean Rock has generated headlines for years, with the two sharing a son, Chrisean Jr. 

Chrisean Rock, whose real name is Chrisean Eugenia Malone, is a Baltimore-born rapper, reality television personality, and social media star. Before becoming famous, she was a talented track-and-field athlete. She gained widespread attention after appearing on Blueface’s reality series Blue Girls Club in 2020. She later built her own following through appearances on Baddies, her reality series Crazy in Love alongside Blueface, and her music career, including her popular song “Vibe.” Her relationship with Blueface has been one of the most heavily discussed relationships on social media. 

Chrisean Rock is once again drawing attention over her famous Blueface portrait tattoo. The reality star originally went viral in January 2024 after getting a large portrait of Blueface tattooed on the side of her face while he was incarcerated. In December 2025, she began undergoing laser treatments to remove the tattoo following their breakup. Now, with Chrisean reportedly wanting to redo the portrait, fans are reacting to another unexpected chapter in their complicated relationship. Although her previous tattoo and removal process are documented, her latest reported plans to redo it have not yet been independently verified.
